name: usage-buffer
description: Stops agents before plan usage limits so a buffer is left for Claude chat; warns agents to wrap up first

weeklyReservePerDay.title: Weekly reserve per day left (%)
weeklyReservePerDay.description: Percent of the weekly limit held back for each day until it resets

weeklyReserveMin.title: Weekly reserve minimum (%)
weeklyReserveMin.description: Never hold back less than this of the weekly limit

weeklyReserveMax.title: Weekly reserve maximum (%)
weeklyReserveMax.description: Never hold back more than this of the weekly limit

fiveHourReserve.title: 5-hour reserve (%)
fiveHourReserve.description: Percent of the 5-hour limit held back

warnMargin.title: Warning margin (points)
warnMargin.description: Start warning you and the agents this many points before the stop level

warnEvery.title: Re-warn agents every (points)
warnEvery.description: Remind each agent again each time usage climbs this many more points

snoozeDefault.title: Default snooze
snoozeDefault.description: How long /usage-buffer snooze lasts with no argument, e.g. 30m, 1h, 2h30m
